Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers serves the city of Modesto and surrounding communities in Stanislaus County, California. Located in downtown Modesto, this courthouse handles a high volume of criminal, civil, family law, probate, and other legal matters. With 17 courtrooms and judges, along with court staff and security personnel, the Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers strives to provide fair and equal access to justice. Read on to learn more about the location, services, cases, staff, security, and general information for this vital county courthouse.

Location and History of Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Address and Location of Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers is centrally located in downtown Modesto at 1100 I Street, Modesto, CA 95354. The courthouse is situated just a few blocks from the Modesto Centre Plaza convention center and Amtrak station. It is also close to Highway 99 for accessibility.

Contact Information and Hours for Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Phone Number, Address, and Website for Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

  • Phone: (209) 530-3100
  • Address: 1100 I Street, Modesto, CA 95354
  • Website: www.stanct.org

Business Hours and Closures for Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The courthouse is open Monday to Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm, excluding holidays. Many departments have specific hours for filings, payments, and appointments. Check the website for details.

History and Background of Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Stanislaus County Superior Court system was established when California became a state in 1850. The current 17-story City Towers building was constructed in 1967 to consolidate county services in one location. In 1989, an additional tower was built next to City Towers to provide more space for the Superior Court. Renovations and upgrades have taken place over the years to improve access and efficiency.

Services and Departments of Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Civil Division at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Civil Division oversees legal disputes between individuals, businesses, organizations and government agencies. These include matters involving contracts, personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, and more.

Criminal Division at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Criminal Division handles proceedings for felony and misdemeanor criminal offenses. These matters range from DUI and theft, to domestic violence, assault, drug charges, and homicide cases.

Family Law Division at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Family Law Division presides over legal issues related to marriage, divorce, child custody and support, guardianships, adoptions, and name changes. Mediation services are also available.

Probate Division at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The Probate Division manages affairs related to wills, trusts, conservatorships, and estates of deceased individuals. It also handles mental health concerns.

Jury Services at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The court manages jury selection and operations. Residents can fulfill jury duty at this courthouse across multiple departments.

Alternative Dispute Resolution at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Mediation and arbitration services aim to resolve disputes outside of court through settlement agreements. Reduced fees apply in certain civil cases.

Courtrooms and Staff at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Courtrooms at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

There are 17 courtrooms utilized for proceedings, most located on floors 11-17. Courtrooms vary in size and layout to accommodate different caseloads and needs.

Judges at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Over 20 Superior Court judges preside over the variety of legal matters that come through the courthouse. Judges are elected officials serving six-year terms.

Court Staff at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

In addition to judges, court staff includes clerks, court reporters, interpreters, mediators, administrators, analysts, and assistants who help proceedings run efficiently.

Popular Cases Heard at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Criminal Cases at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Common criminal cases involve DUIs, drug possession, theft, assault, domestic violence, and homicide. Police officers usually bring cases to be tried before a judge or jury.

Civil Disputes at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Typical civil lawsuits relate to personal injury, medical malpractice, breach of contract, wrongful termination, and disputes between businesses.

Family Law Cases at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Family law matters range from divorce and child custody, to spousal and child support. Paternity, adoption, and guardianship issues are also frequent.

Probate Cases at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Probate proceedings determine the validity of wills and trusts, oversee estate administration, and appoint conservators for those unable to manage their affairs.

Security and Accessibility at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Security Screening at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

Visitors must pass through a security checkpoint upon entering. Bags, items and persons are screened for prohibited objects. Extra security is onsite to maintain safety.

Accessibility Accommodations at Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers

The ADA Coordinator ensures accessible facilities and services for disabled persons. Accommodations include interpreters, assistive listening devices, and mobility assistance.

FAQs

What types of cases are heard at the Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers?

This courthouse handles a wide range of criminal, civil, family law, probate, juvenile, and traffic cases for Stanislaus County. The major divisions include Criminal, Civil, Family Law, and Probate.

How can I get jury duty at the Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers?

You can fill out a jury duty questionnaire online when summoned. The court will review applications and select jurors at random from driver's license and ID databases.

What COVID-19 precautions has the Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers implemented?

COVID safety measures include online hearings, remote appearances, social distancing in courtrooms, mask requirements, and additional cleaning/sanitizing procedures.

How can I access court records or case documents for the Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers?

Court records can be accessed online through the courthouse website portal with proper registration. You can also visit the clerk's office in person to request files.

What types of payments can I make at the Stanislaus County Superior Court – City Towers?

You can make payments for fines, fees, bonds, restitution, and other financial court orders online, by mail, over the phone, or at the courthouse in-person.
